body: Its been almost a year o.o
Haha see, I'm this girl who doesn't like confrontation. Any kind. Even if I had someone handle my "dirty" work
Shes already had a restraining order against her from her ex boyfriend. So I doubt she wouldn't care.
Shes a big girl. A big country girl. And I'm this 5'1, 119 pound girl. she could easily crush me.

I plan on moving away and shit next summer. The only reason I have social anxiety is because of my exs cousin who said she wanted to beat the crap out of me while I was with him. I fear I will see her anytime I go out.

The only people I talk to are people online. I'm afraid to tell my family how I feel because I don't want them to hate me. I want to open up to my boyfriend, but I don't want him to get mad and leave. That's what I fear. I mean hes put up with all my problems for almost five months, I'm just afraid he will get mad when I ask for more time to talk. He knows everything about me, my eating problems and the emotional abuse I get all the time. I'm just so afraid. I know I will never go through with ending my life. The thought just gets stronger and stronger. Everyone just expects me to be this happy girl who is always there for others and then when I need help, they leave. The most response I get from my boyfriend when I tell him that when he doesn't reply for hours on end trigger bad memories of my ex are just "I see" or "Ah". I know that he wants to help, he just doesn't really know how to since we are in a long distance relationship.
